description: Per-application traffic in a time window: calls, owner, number of APIs used, error and throttle counts, average latency. Use for 'top consumers', 'who calls what', 'usage by app'.

configuration.query: FROM apim_event_response, apim_event_faulty | WHERE DATE_DIFF("minute", requestTimestamp, NOW()) <= ?lookback_minutes AND applicationName IS NOT NULL | STATS calls=COUNT(*), apis_used=COUNT_DISTINCT(apiName), errors_5xx=SUM(CASE(proxyResponseCode >= 500, 1, 0)), throttled=SUM(CASE(errorType == "THROTTLED", 1, 0)), avg_latency_ms=AVG(responseLatency) BY applicationName, applicationOwner | EVAL avg_latency_ms=ROUND(avg_latency_ms, 1) | SORT calls DESC

lookback_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (e.g. 60 for the last hour, 1440 for a day).
